# zeroword Provider

Manages Zeroword resources through the Management API. The API key fixes the Workspace: every resource is created in the key's Workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    zeroword = {
      source = "smartcrabai/zeroword"
    }
  }
}

# The API key is read from ZEROWORD_API_KEY when api_key is omitted.
provider "zeroword" {
  base_url = "https://api.staging.zeroword.smartcrab.ai/v1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Workspace-scoped Management API key (`sk_live_...`). Defaults to the `ZEROWORD_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Management API base URL including `/v1`. Defaults to the `ZEROWORD_BASE_URL` environment variable, then `https://api.zeroword.smartcrab.ai/v1`. Staging: `https://api.staging.zeroword.smartcrab.ai/v1`.
